verdict.rationale: The firm's own ChatGD app lets users query and manipulate documents in natural language, including supplying agreements as context via RAG. It is documented only as an internal tool for the firm's attorneys. Client-facing products (Contract Generator, GDHQ, D&O Portal, Catalyze) show no natural-language interface. Missing for 10: client-accessible natural-language operation of the firm's client platforms, documentation of what commands or actions ChatGD supports, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: ChatGD allows the firm's attorneys to query and manipulate documents using a secure, enterprise instance of OpenAI's models through Microsoft Azure.
It also gives attorneys the ability to provide legal agreements or other relevant source material as context for queries using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
